blocks.text: A massive five-year reforestation initiative was officially launched on September 19 at the Cebu Normal University (CNU) Balamban Campus, bringing together over 3,000 local communities, government agencies, and private sector volunteers to restore 1,200 hectares of forest and coastal land in Balamban, Cebu. Coinciding with World Bamboo Day and World Cleanup Day, the CarbonPH x GForest Project unites the Aboitiz Foundation’s long-term nature-based climate action program with GCash GForest, aiming to plant and grow one million trees while fortifying local climate resilience. The landmark gathering drew a diverse roster of key leaders and message speakers who shared their insights during the morning […]...
